programme.desc: Džordžas žavingas ir seksualus vyras, kadaise buvęs tikra futbolo žvaigždė, deja, dabar spindesio jo gyvenime nedaug. Neturintį darbo ir pinigų, jį nuolat lydi nusivylimai. Ar gali jo sūnus Luisas didžiuotis tokiu tėvu? Džordžas nori atitaisyti savo įvaizdį ir įsidarbina sūnaus mokyklos futbolo treneriu. Naujas išvaizdus vyras iškart patraukia kelių berniukų mamų dėmesį. Ar pavyks Džordžui atsispirti senoms pagundoms ir nenuvilti savo sūnaus? Buvusi žmona ruošiasi dar kartą ištekėti ir jos naujas vyras gali būti kur kas geresnis draugas Liuisui nei jo tikras tėvas... Filme vaidina visas būrys Holivudo įžymybių: Džordžą įkūnija Gerardas Butleris, jo buvusią žmoną Jessica Biel, taip pat vaidina Dennisas Quaidas, Cetherine Zeta-Jones, Uma Thurman ir kiti. (Playing for Keeps). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Pirmieji metai. Pasitikime protėvius!.
programme.desc: Pirmieji mūsų eros metai. Du laukiniai žmonės - medžiotojas ir rankiotojas - puikiai sutaria. Kodėl? Juos vienija nevykėlių dalia ir begalinė tinginystė. Gyventojai nebeapsikentę išvaro juos iš kaimo. Užuot surimtėję, šie nevykėliai kiauromis smegeninėmis visiškai nutrūksta nuo grandinių! Jei matėte nors vieną komediją, kurioje vaidina aktorius Jackas Blackas, tuomet iš karto suprasite, kad jūsų laukia arkliška juoko dozė. (Year One). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Atgal i Zeme.
programme.desc: Prieš laiką miręs juodaodis komikas gauna antrą šansą gyventi, atsidūręs turtingo baltojo verslininko kūne. (Down to Earth). [12+]. Fantastiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Auklė Makfi.
programme.desc: "Auklė Makfi" - tai magijos, paslapčių ir humoro kupina istorija, sukurta pagal populiarias Didžiosios Britanijos rašytojos Christiannos Brand knygas. Mirus žmonai, ponas Sedrikas Braunas (akt. Colinas Firthas) lieka vienas su septyniomis atžalomis. Mažieji Braunukai tokie padykę ir išradingi, kad visos potencialios auklės sprunka nuo jų nė neapšilusios pėdų. Bet vieną gražią dieną tarpduryje pasirodo ji - auklė Makfi (akt. Emma Thompson). Ši moteris apvers mažųjų padaužų ir jų nusivylusio tėtušio gyvenimą aukštyn kojomis. Originalus pavadinimas "Nanny McPhee". (Nanny McPhee). Fantastiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Pramuštgalviai.
programme.desc: Muzikinis "Nickelodeon" kompanijos animacinis filmas apie pramuštgalvių šeimynėlės kelionę į anapus jų kiemo esantį pasaulį. Istorija labai patiko viso pasaulio vaikams - filmas uždirbo daugiau kaip 100 milijonų dolerių ir už nugaros paliko daug animacijos giganto "Disney" filmų. Gimus mažajam broliukui Dilui, Tomis ne juokais susirūpina. Mažylis tikrai nėra mielas kūdikis, su kuriuo galima ramiai žaisti, todėl jis nervina ne tik Tomį, bet ir jo draugus. Mažieji padaužos nusprendžia grąžinti rėksnį ten, iš kur jis atėjo, - į ligoninę. Kai vaikai pasiklysta miške, iškyla didelis pavojus. Ar vaikai ras kelią ir galų gale susitaikys? (Rugrats the Movie). Nuotykių. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Vyriškas ping-pongas.
programme.desc: FTB agentas slaptai misijai užverbuoja nuskurdusį buvusį stalo teniso profesionalą. (Balls of Fury). [12+]. Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Amerikos numylėtiniai.
programme.desc: Žymi Holivudo pora susipyko prieš pat savo bendro filmo premjerą. Amerikos numylėtiniai nepateisino lūkesčių ir išgelbėti padėčiai tiks bet kokios priemonės... (America's Sweethearts). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Didysis Lebovskis.
programme.desc: Plėšikai palaiko Džefrį Lebovskį milijonieriumi ir įžūliai niokoja jo kilimą. Sutrikęs Lebovskis su draugu nutarė surasti turčių ir pareikalauti sau naujo kilimo. (The Big Lebowski). [18+]. Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Čarlio Bartleto išdaigos.
programme.desc: Turtingas vaikas pats save paskiria naujos vidurinės mokyklos studentų psichiatru. (Charlie Bartlett). Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Išmuštieji iš vėžių.
programme.desc: Vidurinės ir pagrindinės mokyklos mokinių nuotykiai paskutinę mokslo metų dieną 1976 m. gegužę. (Dazed and Confused). [18+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: P.S. Myliu tave.
programme.desc: Niujorke gyvenančios nekilnojamojo turto agentės Holės (akt. Hilary Swank) gyvenimą sukrečia baisi žinia nuo vėžio miršta jos mylimas vyras Geris. Atsigauti po tokio sukrėtimo nepadeda niekas nei rūpestingos Holės mamos (akt. Kathy Bates) nei geriausių draugių pastangos. Tačiau viskuo prieš iškeliaudamas anapilin jau pasirūpino Geris. 30-ojo gimtadienio proga Holė sulaukia ypatingos dovanos torto ir vaizdajuostės, kurioje jos vyras ragina kuo greičiau pradėti naują gyvenimą. Ir tai dar ne viskas. Nuo šiol kiekvieną mėnesį Holę pasieks laiškai su specialiomis instrukcijomis! (P.S. I Love You). [14+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Vimbldonas.
programme.desc: Peteris Koltas - patyręs teniso žaidėjas, bet jau seniai nebepasiekiantis pergalių. Vaikino nepalieka mintys, kad pasaulyje yra šimtai tūkstančių talentingesnių, jaunesnių, stipresnių, vikresnių teniso žaidėjų. Ruošdamasis turnyrui, Peteris apsistoja viešbutyje ir, sumaišęs kambario numerius, užeina pas žavią merginą Lizi. Šis netikėtas susipažinimas įplieskia meilę. Lizi, kylanti teniso žvaigždė, sugeba įkvėpti Peteriui pasitikėjimo ir ryžto laimėti. Po sunkaus prakaito liejimo maratono kortuose vaikinas galiausiai laimi Vimbldono teniso turnyrą. Ši pergalė pakeičia visą jo gyvenimą ir tikslus…. (Wimbledon). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Debesuota, numatoma mėsos kukulių kruša.
programme.desc: Po pražūtingos maisto audros jaunasis išradėjas Flintas buvo priverstas išvykti iš gimtojo miestelio. Praėjus šiek tiek laiko, jis grįžta į gimtinę ir negali patikėti, kad toji maisto gaminimo mašina, kurią su draugais anuomet sutramdė - atgimė iš naujo. Dabar mašina gamina maistines pabaisas: gyvus ir labai piktus agurkėlius, amžinai alkanas tortilijas, beždžiongrybius ir panašius monstrus. Ko griebsis Flintas, kad juos įveiktų? Animacinę komediją lietuviškai įgarsino: Rolandas Kazlas, Giedrius Arbačiauskas, Arūnas Storpirštis, Olegas Ditkovskis, Agnė Kaktaitė. (Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs). Nuotykių. Komedijos. Fantastiniai.

programme.title: Zulanderis 2.
programme.desc: Praėjo daugiau nei dešimtmetis ir pasaulis užmiršo garsiausią planetos modelį Dereką Zūlanderį ir jo bičiulį Hanzelį. Niekas nebesamdo jų modelio darbui, jų niekas netgi nebeatpažįsta gatvėje. Nusprendę, kad taip tęstis daugiau nebegali, vyrukai žingsnis po žingsnio pradeda savo kelionę atgal į mados pasaulio sostą. Apie tai sužinojusios konkuruojančios kompanijos sunerimsta ir nutaria bet kokia kaina jiems sutrukdyti. Naujausia komiko Beno Stillerio režisuota komedija, kurioje nusifilmavo pats B. Stilleris, Owenas Wilsonas, Penelope Cruz, Justinas Bieberis, Willas Ferrellis ir Mila Jovovich. (Zoolander 2). [12+]. Komedijos. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Aš, tu ir Diupri.
programme.desc: Ką tik iškeptų jaunavedžių Karlo ir Molės gyvenimas negali būti saldesnis - vedybinio gyvenimo malonumai, įsikūrimas naujuose namuose ir klestinčios karjeros. Atrodo, niekas negali sudrumsti idilės. Tačiau, kai į jų gyvenimą įsiveržia Karlo geriausias draugas Diupri, reikalai pasikeičia. Šis vyrukas, sugebantis įsipainioti į keisčiausias istorijas, prarado darbą ir namus. Kiek ilgai seksis pakęsti nevalyvą, liežuvio už dantų nenulaikantį ir drovumo jausmo neturintį draugą? (You, Me and Dupree). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Drilbitas.
programme.desc: Prodiuserio Juddo Apatowo grupė, mums pažįstama iš "Kietakiaušių", ir šį kartą siūlo gardžiai pasijuokti. Trys draugeliai jau nuo pat pirmos dienos vidurinėje mokykloje pajunta spaudimą... kol jie susitinka su Filkinsu. Šis mokyklos chuliganas elgiasi kaip tikras mažasis Hanibalas Lekteris. Draugai paduoda skelbimą į laikraštį "Sėkmės karys", ieškodami to, kuris juos išmokytų apsiginti. Geriausias jiems tinkamas variantas - beje, ir pigiausias - Drilbitas Tailoras, kurį vaidina komikas Owenas Wilsonas. Kokias treniruotes draugužiams surengs patyręs vilkas? (Drillbit Taylor). [12+]. Veiksmo. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Auklė Makfi ir Didysis Sprogimas.
programme.desc: Žavioji auklė Makfi visuomet atsiranda ten, kur jos labiausiai reikia, bet mažiausiai pageidauja. Šįkart ji išdygsta ant slenksčio namų, kuriuose vieniša motina bando tvarkytis su savais ir besisvečiuojančiais vaikais bei gausiu fermos gyventojų būriu. Kadangi vyras kariauja, mamytei jau svyra rankos, o vaikai dėl pas juos viešinčių dviejų išpaikintų pusbrolių iš miesto puolę į neviltį. Auklė Makfi pasiraitoja rankoves ir imasi darbo. Pasitelkusi magiją ir stebuklus - nuo skraidančio motociklo iki mielo netikėčiausiose vietose atsirandančio drambliuko - auklė pamokys vaikus svarbių gyvenimo pamokų, paguos motiną ir į visų jų gyvenimą grąžins tvarką, šilumą bei meilę. (Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang). Fantastiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Pramuštgalviai Paryžiuje.
programme.desc: Populiarūs animacinio filmuko herojai kraustosi į Prancūzijos sostinę! Ten jie lydi išsiblaškėlį tėvą Stju, kuris kviečiamas pataisyti didžiulio dinozauro. Dinozauras priklauso pramogų parkui ir sugedęs negali džiuginti vaikų. Čakis tikisi, kad Paryžiuje ras naują mamą, ir beveik atspėja. Atvykę keliautojai susitinka su parko direktore Koko. Ši netrukus pasirodo esanti baisiai valdinga, tačiau tėtušiai Stju tai nerūpi - jis įsimylėjęs iki ausų. Kaip jį atgrasyti nuo vedybų su blogąja valdytoja? (Rugrats in Paris: The Movie). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Seržantas Bilkas.
programme.desc: Seržantas Bilkas nuo kitų kariškių skiriasi tuo, kad vis imasi ne visai teisėto azartinių žaidimų verslo. Pričiuptas visada mokėjo meistriškai išsisukti. Tačiau šįkart seržantas Bilkas giliai įklimpo - į dalinį atvyksta speciali komisija, o Bilko senas priešas ir varžovas visokiausiais būdais stengiasi jį įskųsti. Seržantas su pavaldiniais visais būdais bando išsisukti ir per visas šias nemalones Bilkas visai pamiršta apie savo vestuves... (Sgt. Bilko). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Mari Huanos ekspresas.
programme.desc: Tingus marihuanos vartotojas tampa vieninteliu žmogžudystės, kurią padaro narkobaronas ir korumpuotas policininkas, liudininku. Gelbėdamas gyvybę jis bėga kartu pasiėmęs savo prekiautoją ir tiekėją. (Pineapple Express). Komedijos. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Senoji mokykla.
programme.desc: Trys draugai – Mičas, Frenkas ir Bernardas – nusivylę savo asmeniniu gyvenimu. Mičas užtiko savo draugę su dviem meilužiais. Frenkas vedė ir suprato, kad jo laisvė baigėsi. Bernardas apsikrovė vaikais ir jau visai nebesidžiaugia gyvenimu... Rodės, kad visiems trims galas... Tačiau kartą Mičas rado gražų namuką, kuris kadaise priklausė vienam koledžo profesoriui. Draugai įpuolė į tą gražų namelį ir surengė smagų studentų vakarėlį. Ūžė, kol linksmybes aptemdė netikėtai pasirodęs dekanas. Gordonas jau seniai griežė dantį ant trijų draugelių, mat šie mokykloje nuolat iš jo tyčiojasi. Taigi dekanas liepė jiems iš namelio išsinešdinti, nes šis priklausąs koledžui. Tik dekanas nežinojo, Mičas, Frenkas ir Bernardas ne iš kelmo spirti. Jie atidžiai perskaitė mokyklos nuostatus ir sumąstė, kaip iš smagus namelio neišsinešdinus – jiems tereikia įkurti studentų broliją. (Old School). Komedijos.

programme.title: Rembo sūnus.
programme.desc: Du dvylikamečiai per ilgas savo vasaros atostogas randa piratinę filmo "Rembo. Pirmasis kraujas" kopiją ir nusprendžia sukurti savą mėgėjišką šio hito variantą. Jaunasis Rembo yra religinės fanatikės vaikas, kuriam draudžiama klausytis muzikos ir žiūrėti TV, jo režisieriniai bandymai suprantami kaip gyvenimas visiškoje nuodėmėje. Tačiau koks linksmas tas gyvenimas ir kaip jis įtraukia aplinkinius vaikus! (Son of Rambow). [12+]. Komedijos. Veiksmo. Dramos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Baimė ir neapykanta Las Vegase.
programme.desc: Keistuolis žurnalistas ir jo psichopatiškas advokatas keliauja į Las Vegasą leistis į psichodelinius nuotykius. (Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas). [18+]. Nuotykių. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Visados kaip pirmą kartą.
programme.desc: Režisierius Peteris Segalas ir aktorius Adamas Sandleris jau ne kartą įrodė, kad kartu gali sukurti stulbinančią komediją. A. Sandlerio herojus - Havajuose gyvenantis jūrų zoologas. Jis visą savo laisvalaikį skiria į Havajus atostogauti atvykusioms moterims vilioti. Tačiau vieną dieną mergišius sutinka mielą ir žavią Liusę, kurią vaidina "Čarlio angelų" žvaigždė Drew Barrymore. Paaiškėja, kad Liusė kenčia nuo trumpalaikio atminties praradimo po autoavarijos. Ji atsimena tik vienos dienos įvykius, todėl kiekvienas rytas - tai rytas po avarijos. Tad Liusė visada sutinka Henrį tarsi pirmą kartą. Bet ką darys patyręs viliotojas, kai pajus, jog įsimylėjo šią keistą merginą? (50 First Dates). Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Meilės guru.
programme.desc: Amerikoje gimęs Pitka visą vaikystę praleidžia Indijoje. Ten ir gimsta jo svajonė tapti pačiu didžiausiu sielovados meistru. Sugrįžęs į Jungtines Valstijas, Pitka nedelsia, imasi siekti užsibrėžto tikslo. Geriausiai sekasi patarinėti meilės klausimais, tad nenuostabu, kad netrukus jis užsitarnauja meilės guru vardą. Puiki galimybė pranokti konkurentus atsiranda tada, kai Pitka gauna užduotį sutaikyti žinomą ledo ritulininką su žmona. Jei pavyktų, tuomet laimingas ledo ritulininkas atvestų savo komandą į pergalę, o kartu Pitka laimėtų geriausio guru vardą. (The Love Guru). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Debesuota, numatoma mėsos kukulių kruša 2.
programme.desc: Jaunojo išradėjo Flinto nuotykiai tęsiasi. Jis su bičiuliais buvo priverstas išvykti iš gimtojo miestelio po jame praūžusios maisto audros. Dabar Flintas gyvena mokslininkų saloje, kurioje karaliauja pažanga ir kuriami netikėčiausi bei moderniausi dalykai. Tačiau šiame rojuje įsikūręs vaikinas galiausiai nutaria apsilankyti gimtinėje. Atvykęs čia Flintas suvokia, kad prieš kelerius metus sutramdyta maisto gaminimo mašina vėl atgijo - dabar ji gamina ne paprastą maistą, o maisto mutantus... (Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2). [12+]. Nuotykių. Komedijos. Fantastiniai.

programme.title: Šeimynėlė.
programme.desc: Šeima trokšta vaikų, todėl nusprendžia įsivaikinti. Jiems pavyksta surasti mielą mergaitę... kuri dar turi mažesnį broliuką ir sesutę. Porelė ryžtasi ir tampa trijų vaikų globėjais. Ką iš tikrųjų reiškia į šeimą priimti ūgtelėjusius vaikus ir su kokiais iššūkiais susidurs naujoji šeima? Vaidina Markas Wahlbergas, Rose Byrne. Originalus pavadinimas "Instant Family". (Instant Family). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Vaiduoklių miestas.
programme.desc: Odontologas Bertramas Pinkusas tikrai nepasižymi draugiškomis savybėmis. Jis nesibodi nušvilpt iš po nosies moteriškei su pirkiniais taksi ar užtrenkia lifto duris prieš skubančius kaimynus… Visas pasitikėjimas savimi išgaruoja, kai vyrukas po tyrimo, kurio metu buvo naudojama narkozė, pradeda matyti vaiduoklius. Jis persigandęs grįžta į medicinos tyrimus atliekančią įstaigą ir sužino, kad tyrimo metu jis buvo miręs, o po 7 minučių netikėtai vėl atsigavo. Dabar visi vaiduokliai, kurie turi nebaigtų reikalų žemėje, į jį kreipiasi pagalbos ir Bertramas negali jiems nepadėti. (Ghost Town). [12+]. Romantiniai. Fantastiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Pramuštgalviai.
programme.desc: Muzikinis "Nickelodeon" kompanijos animacinis filmas apie pramuštgalvių šeimynėlės kelionę į anapus jų kiemo esantį pasaulį. Istorija labai patiko viso pasaulio vaikams - filmas uždirbo daugiau kaip 100 milijonų dolerių ir už nugaros paliko daug animacijos giganto "Disney" filmų. Gimus mažajam broliukui Dilui, Tomis ne juokais susirūpina. Mažylis tikrai nėra mielas kūdikis, su kuriuo galima ramiai žaisti, todėl jis nervina ne tik Tomį, bet ir jo draugus. Mažieji padaužos nusprendžia grąžinti rėksnį ten, iš kur jis atėjo, - į ligoninę. Kai vaikai pasiklysta miške, iškyla didelis pavojus. Ar vaikai ras kelią ir galų gale susitaikys? (Rugrats the Movie). Nuotykių. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Pramuštgalviai iškylauja.
programme.desc: Neįtikėtino smagumo Pramuštgalvių kompanija išsirengia į kelionę laivu. Be nuotykių kelionėje neįdomu! Laivas netikėtai pradeda skęsti ir keliauninkai patenka į egzotišką salą. Tik nepamanykite, kad joje mažyliai bus vieni. Čia pašėlusi Tornberių šeimynėlė filmuoja istoriją apie laukinę gamtą. Leopardas sužino apie salos svečius ir ima juos persekioti. Paskutinė "Nickelodeon" trilogijos apie linksmuosius Pramuštgalvius dalis. (Rugrats Go Wild). Nuotykių. Fantastiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Paslaptingi vyrukai.
programme.desc: Grupelė nekompetentingų mėgėjų superherojų turi išgelbėti dieną, kai superpiktadarys grasina sunaikinti pagrindinį superherojų ir miestą. (Mystery Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Fantastiniai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Vyrai juodais drabužiais: pasaulinė grėsmė.
programme.desc: Po nesėkmingo narkotikų sandorio - daug žuvusių aukų. Šerifas nušauna savo pavaduotoją, o amnezijos ištiktas vyras šauna į šerifą ir pabėga su 3 milijonais dolerių. Kokių pasekmių sulauks 3 milijonus dolerių nušvilpęs bėglys? Originalus pavadinimas "4got10 (The Good, The Bad And The Dead)". (Men in Black: International). [12+]. Komedijos. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Zakas ir Miri kuria porno.
programme.desc: Zakas ir Miri - geriausi draugai. Jie net gyvena kartu. Aišku, jie kartu gyvena ne iš gero gyvenimo: jiems abiems trūksta pinigų. Ir ne šiaip trūksta - jie finansinėje duobėje. Zaką ir Miri net ruošiasi iškraustyti iš buto, o skolų kalnas netrukus juos palaidos. Ką daryti? Netikėtai tapę žvaigždėmis olandiškame Youtube su trumpučiu - ir ne visai padoriu - filmuku, Zakas ir Miri sumąsto planą, kaip prasimanyti pinigų: jie kurs namudinį pornofilmą! (Zack and Miri Make a Porno). [18+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Neįtikėtini Bilo ir Tedo nuotykiai.
programme.desc: Du mokyklos draugai svajoja apie muzikantų karjerą. Jie jau turi roko grupę ir visą laisvalaikį atiduoda rokenrolui. Jeigu vaikinai neatsiskaitys istorijos įskaitos, jų muzikai galas. (Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure). [12+]. Komedijos. Muzikiniai. Romantiniai. Nuotykių.

programme.title: A Bronx Tale.
programme.desc: Drama set in 1960s New York about an Italian American boy surrounded by conflicting influences while growing up in the Bronx. The boy's father is almost powerless to do anything when his son becomes increasingly corrupted by a neighbourhood gangster. The two father figures - one hard-working and loving, the other involved in dangerous, underworld activities - exert conflicting pressures and beliefs. (A Bronx Tale). [12+]. Romantiniai. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Dogworld.
programme.desc: In the near future, Taranto is a ghost town surrounded by barbed wire that no one, not even the police, dares to enter. The poorest are left fighting for survival, while a gang is competing for territory with another gang. Two thirteen-year-old orphans, who grew up together, dream of joining one of the gangs. (Mondocane). Dramos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. programme.title: God Help the Girl.
programme.desc: Emily Browning, Olly Alexander, Hannah Murray and Pierre Boulanger star in first-time screenwriter-director Stuart Murdoch's romantic musical. Murdoch is lead singer and songwriter of Scottish band Belle and Sebastian, and this movie sprang from his side-project album showcasing songs about and sung by women. Browning plays (and sings) the lead role of Eve, an aspiring singer and musician who struggles with an eating disorder and depression. Attending a gig in Glasgow, Eve meets nerdy singer-songwriter James (Alexander), who works as a university lifeguard and teaches guitar. When she gets stranded in the city, he puts her up for the night and the two strike up a friendship that promises romance. They form a band with Cassie (Murray), one of James's guitar students, and together they strive to achieve their dream of stardom. But Eve's friendship with Anton (Boulanger), the frontman of up-and-coming band Wobbly-Legged Rat will cause a series of problems. With Mark Radcliffe, Stuart Maconie and Josie Long. (God Help the Girl). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Helmet Heads.
programme.desc: An easygoing bike messenger faces upheaval when he and his buddies are fired; when his girl Clara plans to move to a motorcycle-free island, the messenger forms a debt-collecting gang to win her back. (Cascos indomables). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Iris.
programme.desc: When the young Iris Murdoch meets fellow student John Bayley at Somerville College, Oxford, he is a naive virgin easily flummoxed by her libertine spirit, arch personality, and obvious artistic talent. Decades later, little has changed and the couple keeps house, with John doting on his more famous wife. When Iris begins experiencing forgetfulness and dementia, however, the devoted John struggles with hopelessness and frustration, and becomes her caretaker, as his wife's mind deteriorates from the ravages of Alzheimer's disease. (Iris). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Investigating Sex.

programme.title: Synecdoche, New York.
programme.desc: Theater director Caden Cotard is mounting a new play. Fresh off of a successful production of Death of a Salesman, he has traded in the suburban blue-hairs and regional theater of Schenectady for the cultured audiences and bright footlights of Broadway. Armed with a MacArthur grant and determined to create a piece of brutal realism and honesty, something into which he can put his whole self, he gathers an ensemble cast into a warehouse in Manhattan's theater district. He directs them in a celebration of the mundane, instructing each to live out their constructed lives in a small mock-up of the city outside. As the city inside the warehouse grows, Caden's own life veers wildly off the tracks. The shadow of his ex-wife Adele, a celebrated painter who left him years ago for Germany's art scene, sneers at him from every corner. Somewhere in Berlin, his daughter Olive is growing up under the questionable guidance of Adele's friend, Maria. He's helplessly driving his marriage to actress ... (Synecdoche, New York). Dramos. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. programme.title: The Iron Lady.
programme.desc: Meryl Streep won both a Best Actress Bafta and Oscar in the titular role of director Phyllida's biopic of the former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, who died recently. Writer Abi Morgan's script follows Thatcher's rise from modest beginnings to her role as Prime Minister, framed by a contemporary imagining of her later years, largely spent outside public scrutiny. The octogenarian Thatcher (Streep) is prompted to reminisce about her life and rise to power, as well as recalling her closest relationships, in particular that with her now-deceased husband Denis (Jim Broadbent). The young Margaret's (Alexandra Roach) ascendance in politics, inspired by her father, begins in the late 40s and takes her to the landmark moment in British history when she leads the Conservative Party to victory in the General Election of 1979, becoming the country's first female Prime Minister. Significant moments in recent history follow - from the Falklands War to the Miner's Strike and the Brighton Grand Hotel bombing - until finally, in 1990, she resigns and leaves 10 Downing Street. While it's impossible to completely eschew Thatcher's politics in a film of this nature - and politicians past and present had much to say on the film's portrait of the PM - the dramatisation is predominantly focused on the story of a woman who smashed gender and class barriers in a male-dominated world; and is ultimately an intimate portrait of an extraordinary and complex woman. programme.title: The Queen.
programme.desc: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Actress, Dame Helen Mirren gives a spellbinding performance in THE QUEEN, the provocative story behind one of the most public tragedies of our time - the sudden death of Princess Diana. In the wake of Diana's death, the very private and tradition-bound Queen Elizabeth II (Mirren) finds herself in conflict with the new Prime Minister, the slickly modern and image-conscious Tony Blair (Michael Sheen). THE QUEEN takes you inside the private chambers of the Royal Family and the British government for a captivating look at a vulnerable human being in her darkest hour, as a nation grieving for its People's Princess waits to see what its leaders will do. (The Queen). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Balloon.
programme.desc: The Strelzyk and Wetzel families live in the GDR and want to leave. In the summer of 1979, after two years of hard work, Peter, his wife Doris and their two children, as well as Günter and Petra and their two sons, finally set off on their escape attempt in a home-made hot air balloon. But their escape from their home in Thuringia ends just before the inner-German border when the balloon crashes. The two families work feverishly to build a new balloon, as the Stasi has now caught on to them and begins its investigation. The GDR secret police still don't know where the balloon crashed, but the noose is tightening. A merciless race against time begins ... (Ballon). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos.

Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere. (Mr. Morgan's Last Love). [12+]. Komedijos. programme.title: Me And You.
programme.desc: Jacopo Olmo Antinori and Tea Falco star in Bernardo Bertolucci's drama about a boy whose scheme to briefly obtain the solitude he craves doesn't quite come off. Lorenzo (Olmo Antinori) is a fairly typical 14-year-old, if a little more introverted and contrary than some; and with a sly sense of humour that runs to asking his mother (Sonia Bergamasco) embarrassingly incestuous questions in restaurants. He's been booked on a school skiing trip, but Lorenzo wants none of that. Instead, he has meticulously planned to skip the outing and spend the week sequestered in the family's basement. But, no sooner than he's settled in, his estranged 25-year-old half-sister Olivia (Falco) pitches up. Not only does she refuse to leave, but she also reveals she has a problem that could make their confinement particularly trying... Also starring Veronica Lazar as Lorenzo's much-loved grandmother. You and Me was Bertolucci's first film in a decade (following an accident that left him using a wheelchair) and his first in Italian in 31 years. In Italian with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Io e te). Dramos.

programme.title: Lolita.
programme.desc: Controversial adaptation of Vladimir Nabokov's novel about a man's obsession with a 13-year-old girl. In an American town in the late 1940s, a European professor takes up residence in the home of a woman and her daughter. Although eventually marrying the mother, he harbours a secret desire for the young girl. And when the mother dies, the middle-aged man's infatuation with the teenager runs amok - with shocking consequences. (Lolita). [18+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Faults.
programme.desc: A cult deprogrammer is hired to help a couple whose daughter is under the influence of a mysterious sect. (Faults). Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Helmet Heads.
programme.desc: An easygoing bike messenger faces upheaval when he and his buddies are fired; when his girl Clara plans to move to a motorcycle-free island, the messenger forms a debt-collecting gang to win her back. (Cascos indomables). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Hypnotist.
programme.desc: Swedish thriller based on the best-selling novels of Lars Kepler. When a man and his family are found brutally murdered in a suburb outside Stockholm, Detective Inspector Joona Linna tries to persuade a doctor, Erik Maria Bark, to hypnotise a traumatised witness. But it has been ten years since Erik last practised hypnosis, and he has promised never to do it again. When he finally agrees, a chain of terrifying events starts. (Hypnotisören). Trileriai. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Bright Star.
programme.desc: Drama based on the doomed love affair between Romantic poet John Keats and the young Fanny Brawne. On the outskirts of 19th-century London, John Keats struggles through grinding poverty and constant ill-health to establish himself as a writer, while the young seamstress Fanny Brawne is intrigued by her secretive neighbour and is determined to seek him out. The two begin a blissful three-year romance of lazy summers and slow burning love, until Keats' protective friend Charles Brown grows wary of Brawne. However, this soon proves to be the least of their problems when Keats' health starts to fail badly, beginning the end of the magical love affair. (Bright Star). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Say Cheese.
programme.desc: Thierry's wife Claire wants to leave him. In a desperate effort to save his marriage Thierry ropes in Claire and the two grown-up children to spend a vacation in Greece exactly as they did on a legendary trip 30 years ago. (On sourit pour la photo). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Wait.
programme.desc: Amidst the large rooms of an old villa marked by time, Anna, emerging from a sudden bereavement, spends her days in solitude. The rugged and beautiful Sicilian countryside surrounds the house and isolates her while the fog, which is slowly climbing the slopes of Mount Etna, prevents the eye seeing any distance. Only the footsteps of Pietro, the handyman, break the silence. And all of a sudden Jeanne appears, a young woman who claims to be the girlfriend of Giuseppe, Anna's son. He invited her to Sicily to spend a few days' holiday together. Anna was unaware of Jeanne's existence. And Giuseppe is not there. But his things are all there, in his room. Soon, very soon he will return, is what Anna says, unable to reveal a truth that for her cannot be spoken. The days pass, the two women slowly get to know each other, and together they begin to wait for Easter, when Giuseppe will finally come home, and a great traditional procession will be held in the village. (L'attesa). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Allelujah.
programme.desc: The Beth, a small community NHS geriatric facility in Yorkshire, is facing closure because of Whitehall budget cuts. Colin, a management consultant for the health department, arrives to visit his ailing ex-miner father and to make an appraisal. Meanwhile, the staff and patients are preparing a presentation for the formidable Nurse Gilpin, who is to be presented with a long service medal. Based on the successful stage play by Alan Bennett. (Allelujah). [7+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Silent Revolution.
programme.desc: A group of twelfth-grade pupils in East Germany decide to show their solidarity with the victims of the 1956 Hungarian uprising by staging two minutes of silence during lessons. (Das schweigende Klassenzimmer). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Queen.
programme.desc: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Actress, Dame Helen Mirren gives a spellbinding performance in THE QUEEN, the provocative story behind one of the most public tragedies of our time - the sudden death of Princess Diana. In the wake of Diana's death, the very private and tradition-bound Queen Elizabeth II (Mirren) finds herself in conflict with the new Prime Minister, the slickly modern and image-conscious Tony Blair (Michael Sheen). THE QUEEN takes you inside the private chambers of the Royal Family and the British government for a captivating look at a vulnerable human being in her darkest hour, as a nation grieving for its People's Princess waits to see what its leaders will do. (The Queen). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Sea Of Time.
programme.desc: Lucas and Johanna live in the 80s, madly in love, in a world full of dreams and ideals. Then a disastrous accident, during their sailing trip on the Atlantic, separates them. Thirty-five years later, in the autumn of their lives, the two of them meet again and their deep-rooted love is still very strong. Will Johanna dare to trust Lucas and let him into her deep secret from the past? (Sea of Time). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Chef's Wife.
programme.desc: The wife of a successful chef feels unfulfilled in her rôle as dining-room hostess and consults career counselor, who is herself dissatisfied by her useful but mundane place in the scheme of things. Without meaning to, the two women find their lives growing tangled together, with ever more complex tragicomic consequences. (On a failli être amies). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Shopping.
programme.desc: In a small town in New Zealand, brothers Willie and Solomon deal with the ordinary desires of youth, a volatile father, and racial tensions before one, as a means of escape, is seduced to the criminal world by an engaging thief. (Shopping). Dramos.

programme.title: Now or Never.
programme.desc: Everything seems to be going right for a part-time piano teacher, Juliette. She's the mother of two fun-loving and well behaved boys, while her husband, Charlie, has a finance job that's allowed them to build a beautiful country house they'll be moving into next month. But when Charlie gets canned from work and can no longer pay his mortgage payments, the creditors quickly threaten to repossess the property, leaving his family stranded in their cramped Paris apartment. Only a few days later, Juliette gets her purse snatched by a brooding, attractive street thug named Manu. When she's called to identify him in a police lineup, she decides to let him go, only to solicit his help in her scheme to steal a half-million Euros from a local bank. (Maintenant ou jamais). [18+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: A Woman in Winter.
programme.desc: An astronomer enters into a destructive affair with a photographer. (A Woman in Winter). Dramos.

programme.title: Initials SG.
programme.desc: "Struggling actor" is a euphemism for 50-year-old suave, nevertheless professionally washed-up Argentinian Sergio Garces, who is still reminiscing about a long-forgotten cover album of Serge Gainsbourg's songs he had recorded in his youth. To him, the two of them share not only a slight resemblance and common initials, but the singer's enticing aura as well. As the World Cup final between Argentina and Germany is closing in, plunging Buenos Aires in anticipation frenzy, Sergio's streak of ridiculously bad luck is about to reach a record-high. A sui generis blend of offbeat dramedy, crime caper and surreal dark comedy, set against a backdrop of dead-serious sarcasm. (Initials SG). [16+]. Muzikiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Madame Bovary.
programme.desc: Bored in her marriage to a country doctor and stifled by life in a small town, the restless Emma Bovary pursues her dreams of passion and excitement at any cost. (Madame Bovary). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Iron Lady.
programme.desc: Meryl Streep won both a Best Actress Bafta and Oscar in the titular role of director Phyllida's biopic of the former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, who died recently. Writer Abi Morgan's script follows Thatcher's rise from modest beginnings to her role as Prime Minister, framed by a contemporary imagining of her later years, largely spent outside public scrutiny. The octogenarian Thatcher (Streep) is prompted to reminisce about her life and rise to power, as well as recalling her closest relationships, in particular that with her now-deceased husband Denis (Jim Broadbent). The young Margaret's (Alexandra Roach) ascendance in politics, inspired by her father, begins in the late 40s and takes her to the landmark moment in British history when she leads the Conservative Party to victory in the General Election of 1979, becoming the country's first female Prime Minister. Significant moments in recent history follow - from the Falklands War to the Miner's Strike and the Brighton Grand Hotel bombing - until finally, in 1990, she resigns and leaves 10 Downing Street. While it's impossible to completely eschew Thatcher's politics in a film of this nature - and politicians past and present had much to say on the film's portrait of the PM - the dramatisation is predominantly focused on the story of a woman who smashed gender and class barriers in a male-dominated world; and is ultimately an intimate portrait of an extraordinary and complex woman. Also starring Olivia Colman (as Carol Thatcher), Harry Lloyd (as a young Denis), Anthony Head (as Geoffrey Howe), Richard E Grant (as Michael Heseltine) and Roger Allam (as Gordon Reece). A Film4 co-production. (The Iron Lady). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Tenor.
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice. (Ténor). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Albatros.
programme.desc: Laurent, a police officer in a small town in Normandy, plans to marry Marie, with whom he has a daughter. Then one day, his life is thrown into turmoil when he accidentally kills a farmer threatening to commit suicide. (Albatros). Dramos.

programme.title: Beauty And the Beast.
programme.desc: A widowed merchant moves to the countryside with his six children after going bankrupt. His youngest daughter, Belle, is the only one happy with the change. When the merchant's lost ship is found, he plans to reclaim his assets. On the way, he encounters the Beast's magical domain, where his needs are met. However, he is caught picking a rose and must return to the castle or his family will be killed. Feeling responsible, Belle offers herself in her father's place. (La Belle et la Bête). [12+]. Trileriai. Romantiniai. Dramos. Fantastiniai.

programme.title: Discount.
programme.desc: In a gloomy northern suburb where everyone wears a perpetual frown, one of the only major employers in the area seems to be Discount, a medium-sized, low-cost market that attracts crowds of working-class shoppers every morning. Managed with an iron first by the stressed, perpetually single Sofia, the cashiers Gilles, Christiane, Emma and Alfred fight to keep their jobs despite the constant threat of layoffs and the store's draconian rules regarding customer service and bathroom breaks, which are timed with a stopwatch. When Sofia is forced by her own horrible bosses to start issuing pink slips, Gilles convinces his fellow employees to fight back in a completely unexpected manner: stealing boxes of product from Discount and reselling them for even less in a makeshift shop that they open in Christiane's garage. (Discount). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Hannes.
programme.desc: Born at the same place, on the same day, Hannes and Moritz grow up to be inseparable friends. But one day a tragic motorcycle accident will change their lives forever, leaving Hannes in a coma with a slim chance of recovery. Moritz refuses to give up on his friend and puts his own life aside to ensure Hannes is always loved and surrounded by life and laughter. Trying to stand his ground, Moritz will then embark on an inspiring and life-changing journey, realizing that every day is worth celebrating and proving their friendship is stronger than ever. (Hannes). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: A Man Standing.
programme.desc: Clémence Alpharo, who, in order to get a permanent contract in the company that has just hired her, must push Henri Giffard, a sales representative at the end of his career, towards early retirement. But Giffard refuses. His work is the only thing that still gives meaning to his life. Caught between the prospect of a professional future that would allow her to escape her family history and the unexpected affection she feels for the salesman, Clémence must choose. A choice that will inexorably push Clémence and Henri to the limit. (L'Homme debout). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Nannies.
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her. (Les femmes du square). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Stealing Beauty.
programme.desc: Lucy Harmon, a nineteen-year-old American, is the daughter of well-known (now deceased) poet and model, Sara Harmon. The film opens as Lucy arrives for a vacation at the Tuscany villa of Sara's old friends, Ian and Diana Grayson (played by Donal McCann and Cusack, respectively). Other guests include a prominent New York art gallery owner, an Italian advice columnist and an English writer, Alex Parrish (Irons), who is dying of an unspecified disease. Lucy goes for a swim, and finds that Diana's daughter from a previous marriage, Miranda Fox (Weisz), is also there with her boyfriend, entertainment lawyer Richard Reed (D. W. Moffett). Miranda's brother, Christopher (Fiennes), is supposed to be there, but he is off on a road trip with the Italian son of a neighboring villa, Niccoló Donati (Roberto Zibetti). Lucy was particularly hoping to see Niccoló, whom she had met on a previous visit to the villa, four years earlier, and who was the first boy she'd ever kissed. Lucy and Niccoló had briefly exchanged letters after this first visit. One letter in particular Lucy had admired so much she memorized it. (Stealing Beauty). [12+]. Dramos. Mistika. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Spell.
programme.desc: Following the unexpected death of his fiancee, an American illustrator embarks on a soul-searching journey across the isolated Icelandic countryside, only to become drawn into a supernatural world of ancient runes and secrets. In his vulnerable state, he meets a powerful magician who can raise the dead, and locals who convince him to proceed with the ritual. Very dangerous, unless it's all in his head. (Spell). [16+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: God Help the Girl.
programme.desc: Emily Browning, Olly Alexander, Hannah Murray and Pierre Boulanger star in first-time screenwriter-director Stuart Murdoch's romantic musical. Murdoch is lead singer and songwriter of Scottish band Belle and Sebastian, and this movie sprang from his side-project album showcasing songs about and sung by women. Browning plays (and sings) the lead role of Eve, an aspiring singer and musician who struggles with an eating disorder and depression. Attending a gig in Glasgow, Eve meets nerdy singer-songwriter James (Alexander), who works as a university lifeguard and teaches guitar. When she gets stranded in the city, he puts her up for the night and the two strike up a friendship that promises romance. They form a band with Cassie (Murray), one of James's guitar students, and together they strive to achieve their dream of stardom. But Eve's friendship with Anton (Boulanger), the frontman of up-and-coming band Wobbly-Legged Rat will cause a series of problems. With Mark Radcliffe, Stuart Maconie and Josie Long. (God Help the Girl). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Rounding.
programme.desc: A driven young medical resident transfers to a rural hospital for a fresh start, but the demons of his past start to catch up to him when he becomes consumed by the case of a young asthma patient. (Rounding). [18+]. Mistika. Dramos. Siaubo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Dogworld.
programme.desc: In the near future, Taranto is a ghost town surrounded by barbed wire that no one, not even the police, dares to enter. The poorest are left fighting for survival, while a gang is competing for territory with another gang. Two thirteen-year-old orphans, who grew up together, dream of joining one of the gangs. (Mondocane). Dramos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle.
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Faultless.
programme.desc: Jobless Constance returns to her home town and learns that there's a vacancy at the estate agency where she began her career. Her former boss finally ends up choosing a younger applicant. But Constance is ready to do anything to recover the job she sees as rightfully hers. Direction, screenplay: Sébastien Marnier (France, 2015) (Irréprochable). [12+]. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: All Because of the Cat.
programme.desc: On the cusp of 50, a woman can't stand anything any more; the only person who finds favour in her eyes - and is her only ally - is her cat Max. (Ma langue au chat). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Santosh.
programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural badlands of Northern India. When a girl's body is found, she's pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma. (Santosh). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Maine.
programme.desc: While solo hiking the Appalachian Trail, a married woman from Spain's journey to reclaim her identity becomes sidetracked when a lone American hiker pursues her. (Maine). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Asako I & II.
programme.desc: Asako lives in Osaka. She falls in love with Baku, a free-spirit. One day, Baku suddenly disappears. Two years later, Asako now lives in Tokyo and meets Ryohei. He looks just like Baku, but has a completely different personality. (Netemo sametemo). Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Lolita.
programme.desc: Controversial adaptation of Vladimir Nabokov's novel about a man's obsession with a 13-year-old girl. In an American town in the late 1940s, a European professor takes up residence in the home of a woman and her daughter. Although eventually marrying the mother, he harbours a secret desire for the young girl. And when the mother dies, the middle-aged man's infatuation with the teenager runs amok - with shocking consequences. (Lolita). [18+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love.
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere. (Mr. Morgan's Last Love). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Dramos. Muzikiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Nannies.
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her. (Les femmes du square). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Little One.
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, after a happy young couple have just welcomed their first child, the four new grandparents start vying for exclusive control of the baby in a rivalry that spirals out of control. (Boutchou). Komedijos.

programme.title: The Most Fun You Can Have Dying.
programme.desc: The murder of Richard Speigel, chief financial officer for an exclusive, family-owned department store goes from the sitting room to the bedroom and into the board room as suspicion shifts from co-workers to family members. (The Most Fun You Can Have Dying). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Disobedient.
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement. (Neposlusni). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Balloon.
programme.desc: The Strelzyk and Wetzel families live in the GDR and want to leave. In the summer of 1979, after two years of hard work, Peter, his wife Doris and their two children, as well as Günter and Petra and their two sons, finally set off on their escape attempt in a home-made hot air balloon. But their escape from their home in Thuringia ends just before the inner-German border when the balloon crashes. The two families work feverishly to build a new balloon, as the Stasi has now caught on to them and begins its investigation. The GDR secret police still don't know where the balloon crashed, but the noose is tightening. A merciless race against time begins ... (Ballon). [12+]. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Now or Never.
programme.desc: Everything seems to be going right for a part-time piano teacher, Juliette. She's the mother of two fun-loving and well behaved boys, while her husband, Charlie, has a finance job that's allowed them to build a beautiful country house they'll be moving into next month. But when Charlie gets canned from work and can no longer pay his mortgage payments, the creditors quickly threaten to repossess the property, leaving his family stranded in their cramped Paris apartment. Only a few days later, Juliette gets her purse snatched by a brooding, attractive street thug named Manu. When she's called to identify him in a police lineup, she decides to let him go, only to solicit his help in her scheme to steal a half-million Euros from a local bank. (Maintenant ou jamais). [18+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Veiksmo. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale.
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship. (Mozart and the Whale). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Silent Revolution.
programme.desc: A group of twelfth-grade pupils in East Germany decide to show their solidarity with the victims of the 1956 Hungarian uprising by staging two minutes of silence during lessons. (Das schweigende Klassenzimmer). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Queen.
programme.desc: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Actress, Dame Helen Mirren gives a spellbinding performance in THE QUEEN, the provocative story behind one of the most public tragedies of our time - the sudden death of Princess Diana. In the wake of Diana's death, the very private and tradition-bound Queen Elizabeth II (Mirren) finds herself in conflict with the new Prime Minister, the slickly modern and image-conscious Tony Blair (Michael Sheen). THE QUEEN takes you inside the private chambers of the Royal Family and the British government for a captivating look at a vulnerable human being in her darkest hour, as a nation grieving for its People's Princess waits to see what its leaders will do. (The Queen). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Sea Of Time.
programme.desc: Lucas and Johanna live in the 80s, madly in love, in a world full of dreams and ideals. Then a disastrous accident, during their sailing trip on the Atlantic, separates them. Thirty-five years later, in the autumn of their lives, the two of them meet again and their deep-rooted love is still very strong. Will Johanna dare to trust Lucas and let him into her deep secret from the past? (Sea of Time). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Chef's Wife.
programme.desc: The wife of a successful chef feels unfulfilled in her rôle as dining-room hostess and consults career counselor, who is herself dissatisfied by her useful but mundane place in the scheme of things. Without meaning to, the two women find their lives growing tangled together, with ever more complex tragicomic consequences. (On a failli être amies). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Faultless.
programme.desc: Jobless Constance returns to her home town and learns that there's a vacancy at the estate agency where she began her career. Her former boss finally ends up choosing a younger applicant. But Constance is ready to do anything to recover the job she sees as rightfully hers. Direction, screenplay: Sébastien Marnier (France, 2015) (Irréprochable). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: All Because of the Cat.
programme.desc: On the cusp of 50, a woman can't stand anything any more; the only person who finds favour in her eyes - and is her only ally - is her cat Max. (Ma langue au chat). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Ladykillers.
programme.desc: The last of the great Ealing comedies. Despite a distinguished cast including Alec Guinness, Peter Sellers, Jack Warner and Herbert Lom, it is Katie Johnson who steals the show as the little old lady who innocently takes in a criminal gang believing them to be a string quintet. When she discovers that they have just robbed a bank and insists that they give themselves up to the police, the gang decide that Mrs Wilberforce must die - but none of them can steel themselves to kill her. Frankie Howerd also has a cameo role as a barrow boy. (The Ladykillers). [16+]. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love.
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere. (Mr. Morgan's Last Love). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Ramen Shop.
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients. (Ramen Teh). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: She's Lost Control.
programme.desc: While studying for her master's degree, Ronah works as sexual surrogate in New York City under therapist Dr. Alan Cassidy. Cassidy refers to her a new client, Johnny, a man with intimacy issues. On their first appointment, Johnny drinks alcohol, which Ronah discourages, though she says he can discuss the matter with Cassidy. Johnny's hostility to Ronah's attempts to get him to open up eventually leads him to reveal in one session that he does not trust her and desires to strangle her. In her progress reports with Cassidy, Ronah confirms her desire to continue working with him, as she does not want to give up on him. Johnny continues to drink during their sessions, citing a guideline from Cassidy that one drink before their session is fine. (She's Lost Control). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Me And You.
programme.desc: Jacopo Olmo Antinori and Tea Falco star in Bernardo Bertolucci's drama about a boy whose scheme to briefly obtain the solitude he craves doesn't quite come off. Lorenzo (Olmo Antinori) is a fairly typical 14-year-old, if a little more introverted and contrary than some; and with a sly sense of humour that runs to asking his mother (Sonia Bergamasco) embarrassingly incestuous questions in restaurants. He's been booked on a school skiing trip, but Lorenzo wants none of that. Instead, he has meticulously planned to skip the outing and spend the week sequestered in the family's basement. But, no sooner than he's settled in, his estranged 25-year-old half-sister Olivia (Falco) pitches up. Not only does she refuse to leave, but she also reveals she has a problem that could make their confinement particularly trying... Also starring Veronica Lazar as Lorenzo's much-loved grandmother. You and Me was Bertolucci's first film in a decade (following an accident that left him using a wheelchair) and his first in Italian in 31 years. In Italian with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Io e te). Dramos.

programme.title: Spell.
programme.desc: Following the unexpected death of his fiancee, an American illustrator embarks on a soul-searching journey across the isolated Icelandic countryside, only to become drawn into a supernatural world of ancient runes and secrets. In his vulnerable state, he meets a powerful magician who can raise the dead, and locals who convince him to proceed with the ritual. Very dangerous, unless it's all in his head. (Spell). [16+]. Komedijos. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Lolita.
programme.desc: Controversial adaptation of Vladimir Nabokov's novel about a man's obsession with a 13-year-old girl. In an American town in the late 1940s, a European professor takes up residence in the home of a woman and her daughter. Although eventually marrying the mother, he harbours a secret desire for the young girl. And when the mother dies, the middle-aged man's infatuation with the teenager runs amok - with shocking consequences. (Lolita). [18+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Painted Veil.
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth. (The Painted Veil). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Hannes.
programme.desc: Born at the same place, on the same day, Hannes and Moritz grow up to be inseparable friends. But one day a tragic motorcycle accident will change their lives forever, leaving Hannes in a coma with a slim chance of recovery. Moritz refuses to give up on his friend and puts his own life aside to ensure Hannes is always loved and surrounded by life and laughter. Trying to stand his ground, Moritz will then embark on an inspiring and life-changing journey, realizing that every day is worth celebrating and proving their friendship is stronger than ever. (Hannes). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: A Man Standing.
programme.desc: Clémence Alpharo, who, in order to get a permanent contract in the company that has just hired her, must push Henri Giffard, a sales representative at the end of his career, towards early retirement. But Giffard refuses. His work is the only thing that still gives meaning to his life. Caught between the prospect of a professional future that would allow her to escape her family history and the unexpected affection she feels for the salesman, Clémence must choose. A choice that will inexorably push Clémence and Henri to the limit. (L'Homme debout). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Nannies.
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her. (Les femmes du square). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Little One.
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, after a happy young couple have just welcomed their first child, the four new grandparents start vying for exclusive control of the baby in a rivalry that spirals out of control. (Boutchou). Komedijos.

programme.title: Death on the Nile.
programme.desc: During a luxurious pleasure cruise down the Nile aboard a lavish vessel populated with wealthy passengers, widely despised heiress and home wrecker Linnet Ridgeway is murdered. Also aboard is famed Belgian detective Poirot and his taciturn traveling companion, Colonel Race. Poirot undertakes an investigation into Ridgeway's killing, but as more bodies pile up, it appears that nearly everyone aboard has a motive. (Death on the Nile). [18+]. Dramos. Mistika. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Plancha.
programme.desc: To celebrate Yves' 50th birthday, his friends plan to take him to the sunny paradise of Paros in Greece. But due to a flight cancellation, the holiday will take place in a much rainier destination: Yves' family home in Brittany. (Plancha). Komedijos.

programme.title: The Braves.
programme.desc: Margaux and Alma share a love of the theatre. Although sometimes finding themselves competing for a role, they remain best friends. Despite everything, they make progress and seem unstoppable. Alma and Margot's relationship really is ''for better and for worse''. (Entre les vagues). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: How He Fell in Love.
programme.desc: Travis, a struggling young musician, crosses paths with Ellen, an older, married yoga instructor who is in the process of adopting a child. Travis and Ellen begin an affair that slowly deepens into something more intimate and profound. As their encounters continue, Travis must face the consequences of infidelity while Ellen is confronted with her crumbling marriage. (How he fell in love). [18+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Shopping.
programme.desc: In a small town in New Zealand, brothers Willie and Solomon deal with the ordinary desires of youth, a volatile father, and racial tensions before one, as a means of escape, is seduced to the criminal world by an engaging thief. (Shopping). Dramos.

programme.title: Nostalgia.
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles (Nostalgia). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Discount.
programme.desc: In a gloomy northern suburb where everyone wears a perpetual frown, one of the only major employers in the area seems to be Discount, a medium-sized, low-cost market that attracts crowds of working-class shoppers every morning. Managed with an iron first by the stressed, perpetually single Sofia, the cashiers Gilles, Christiane, Emma and Alfred fight to keep their jobs despite the constant threat of layoffs and the store's draconian rules regarding customer service and bathroom breaks, which are timed with a stopwatch. When Sofia is forced by her own horrible bosses to start issuing pink slips, Gilles convinces his fellow employees to fight back in a completely unexpected manner: stealing boxes of product from Discount and reselling them for even less in a makeshift shop that they open in Christiane's garage. (Discount). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Sea Of Time.
programme.desc: Lucas and Johanna live in the 80s, madly in love, in a world full of dreams and ideals. Then a disastrous accident, during their sailing trip on the Atlantic, separates them. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: You Ain't Seen Nothin' Yet.
programme.desc: From beyond the grave, celebrated playwright Antoine d'Anthac gathers together all his friends who have appeared over the years in his play "Eurydice." These actors watch a recording of the work performed by a young acting company, La Compagnie de la Colombe. During the screening, Antoine's friends are so overwhelmed by their memories of the play that they start performing it together, despite no longer being the appropriate age for their various roles. (Vous n'avez encore rien vu). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Princess of Montpensier.
programme.desc: France, 1562. Against a background of the savage Catholic/Protestant wars, Marie de Mézières (Mélanie Thierry), a beautiful young aristocrat, and the rakish Henri de Guise (Gaspard Ulliel) fall in love, but Marie's father has promised her hand in marriage to the Prince of Montpensier (Grégoire Leprince-Ringuet). When he is called away to battle, her husband leaves her in the care of Count Chabannes (Lambert Wilson), an aging nobleman with a disdain for warfare. As he experiences his own forbidden desire for Marie, Chabannes must also protect her from the dangerously corrupt court dominated by Catherine de Medici. (La princesse de Montpensier). [12+]. Veiksmo. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights.
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival. (Wuthering Heights). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Family Life.
programme.desc: A young man spends a few weeks housekeeping for a distant relative. Soon, he meets a cute neighbor and starts pretending for his personal benefit. (Vida de Familia). [16+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Stealing Beauty.
programme.desc: Lucy Harmon, a nineteen-year-old American, is the daughter of well-known (now deceased) poet and model, Sara Harmon. The film opens as Lucy arrives for a vacation at the Tuscany villa of Sara's old friends, Ian and Diana Grayson (played by Donal McCann and Cusack, respectively). Other guests include a prominent New York art gallery owner, an Italian advice columnist and an English writer, Alex Parrish (Irons), who is dying of an unspecified disease. Lucy goes for a swim, and finds that Diana's daughter from a previous marriage, Miranda Fox (Weisz), is also there with her boyfriend, entertainment lawyer Richard Reed (D. W. Moffett). Miranda's brother, Christopher (Fiennes), is supposed to be there, but he is off on a road trip with the Italian son of a neighboring villa, Niccoló Donati (Roberto Zibetti). Lucy was particularly hoping to see Niccoló, whom she had met on a previous visit to the villa, four years earlier, and who was the first boy she'd ever kissed. Lucy and Niccoló had briefly exchanged letters after this first visit. One letter in particular Lucy had admired so much she memorized it. (Stealing Beauty). [12+]. Mistika. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Disobedient.

Surrounded by beautiful women, legendary musicians, a stone-cold hustler, a righteous preacher, and a wolf pack of kids, the sweet, yet unstable, performer avoids the recording studio, driven by his own form of self-discovery. His journey quickly drags him from love and happiness right to the edge of another dimension. (Memphis). [16+]. Dramos.
